ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE initialise_windows IS
BEGIN
 :system.message_level := '10';
/***
 :parameter.p_chapter_id := 'WAD';
--'DRV0124829';
 :parameter.p_drive_id := 'DRV0133156';
***/
 if :parameter.p_drive_id is null OR
 :parameter.p_chapter_id is null then
 show_error('18023');
 exit_form(no_validate);
 end if;

-- [ver: 01] change to [ver: 02] for IM 2216
-- [ver: 02] change to [ver: 03] for IM 5818
-- [ver: 03] change to [ver: 04] for IM 8497
--:global.program_version := '05'; -- duplicate objects removal from GRP_LAF_STND

--:global.program_versin := '01'; -- valid_attributes_don
 set_window_property('win_donation',
 title, :banner.prog_name || ' [ver: 01] ' ||
 ' Drive Statistics for - ' || :parameter.p_drive_id);


/***
 set_window_property('win_donation',
 title,
 '[' || :banner.prog_name || ' - 1.01.03] ' ||
 ' Drive Statistics for - ' || :parameter.p_drive_id);
****/

 /*
** this procedure will do the actual work.
*/
--PROCEDURE populate_drives IS
declare
 Driveid varchar2(10) := :parameter.p_drive_id;
 Chapterid varchar2(5) := :parameter.p_chapter_id;
 TotalDon number;
BEGIN
 select count(*) into totaldon
 from donations
 where drive_id = driveid and
 chapter_id = chapterid;
 /** Commented out and changes made for (IM 2216)
 set_window_property('win_donation',
 title,
 get_window_property('win_donation', title) ||
 ' Total Donations - ' || to_char(totaldon));
 ****/
 
 set_window_property('win_donation',
 title,
 get_window_property('win_donation', title) ||
 ' Total Donations - ' || to_char(totaldon));
 begin 
 select count(*) 
 into :ctrl_block.actual_draw
 from donations
 where drive_id = driveid and
 chapter_id = chapterid and
 unit_id is not null;
 exception
 when others then
 message(sqlerrm);pause;
 end;
 begin
 select count(*) 
 into :ctrl_block.act_deferral
 from donations
 where drive_id = driveid and 
 chapter_id = chapterid and
 unit_id is null;
 exception
 when others then
 message(sqlerrm);pause;
 end;

 begin
 select ds.sponsor_id,name,to_char(drive_date,'MM-DD-YYYY'),d.projected_show,d.projected_draw,
 ds.proj_deferral_rate,d.drive_type,v.description
 into :ctrl_block.sponsor_id,:ctrl_block.name,:ctrl_block.drive_date,
 :ctrl_block.projected_show,:ctrl_block.projected_draw,
 :ctrl_block.proj_deferral_rate,:ctrl_block.drive_type,:ctrl_block.type_desc
 from sponsors s,drive_sponsors ds,drives d,valid_master_codes v
 where d.chapter_id = chapterid and
 d.drive_id = driveid and
 ds.drive_id = d.drive_id and
 ds.chapter_id = d.chapter_id and
 s.sponsor_id = ds.sponsor_id and
 s.chapter_id = ds.chapter_id and
 v.code_type = 'DRVTY' and
 v.code = d.drive_type and
 sysdate between v.eff_date and nvl(v.term_date,sysdate+1) and
 rownum < 2;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end; 
 --message('retrieved drive details');pause;
 --pitss synchronize;

 if (:ctrl_block.actual_draw + :ctrl_block.act_deferral) > 0 then -- divide by zero check
 :ctrl_block.act_deferral_rate := round(nvl((:ctrl_block.act_deferral*100/(:ctrl_block.actual_draw + :ctrl_block.act_deferral)),0),2);
 end if;
 if :ctrl_block.projected_show > 0 then 
 :ctrl_block.proj_deferral_rate :=round( ((:ctrl_block.projected_show - :ctrl_block.projected_draw)*100
 /:ctrl_block.projected_show ),2);
 end if;
END; --populate_drives;
 --check_package_failure;


--PROCEDURE populate_donation IS
declare
 CURSOR good_count IS
 SELECT d.donation_type,d.procedure_code,vpc.sort_sequence,count(*) cnt
 FROM DONATIONS d,valid_proc_codes vpc
 WHERE d.drive_id = :parameter.p_drive_id and
 d.chapter_id = :parameter.p_chapter_id and
 d.procedure_code = vpc.procedure_code and
 unit_id is not null 
/* and
 NOT EXISTS
 ( SELECT transaction_id 
 FROM DONATION_ATTRIBUTES
 WHERE transaction_id = d.transaction_id and
 chapter_id = :parameter.p_chapter_id and
 attrib_code = 'VENI' )
*/
 GROUP BY d.donation_type,d.procedure_code,vpc.sort_sequence
 ORDER BY d.donation_type,vpc.sort_sequence; 

 CURSOR bad_count IS
 SELECT d.attrib_value, v.attrib_desc,count(*) cnt
 FROM DONATION_ATTRIBUTES d,valid_attributes_don v --- LT 2018
 WHERE d.transaction_id IN 
 ( SELECT transaction_id
 FROM DONATIONS don
 WHERE don.drive_id = :parameter.p_drive_id and
 don.chapter_id = :parameter.p_chapter_id and
 don.unit_id is not null ) and
 d.attrib_code = 'VENI' and
 v.attrib_group = 'VENI' and
 v.attrib_table = 'DONATION_ATTRIBUTES' and
 d.attrib_value = v.attrib_code 
 GROUP BY d.attrib_value,v.attrib_desc 
 ORDER BY d.attrib_value;

 CURSOR def_count IS
 SELECT di.inter_code,di.originated_from,count(*) cnt
 FROM DONOR_INTERDICTIONS di
 WHERE transaction_id IN
 (SELECT transaction_id
 FROM DONATIONS
 WHERE drive_id = :parameter.p_drive_id and
 chapter_id = :parameter.p_chapter_id and
 unit_id is null and
 donation_type != 'AU' and
 donation_type != 'TH' ) and
 inter_code in ('PHYTD','PHYPD','HDI','HDT')
 GROUP BY di.inter_code,di.originated_from
 ORDER BY di.inter_code,di.originated_from;

 CURSOR auto_def_count IS
 SELECT di.inter_code,di.originated_from,count(*) cnt
 FROM DONOR_INTERDICTIONS di
 WHERE transaction_id IN
 (SELECT transaction_id
 FROM DONATIONS
 WHERE drive_id = :parameter.p_drive_id and
 chapter_id = :parameter.p_chapter_id and
 unit_id is null and
 (donation_type = 'AU' or
 donation_type = 'TH' ) ) and 
 inter_code in ('PHYTD','PHYPD','HDI','HDT')
 GROUP BY di.inter_code,di.originated_from
 ORDER BY di.inter_code,di.originated_from;

BEGIN
 set_block_property('donations',INSERT_ALLOWED,property_true);
 go_block('donations');
 --clear_block(no_validate);
 FOR c1 IN good_count LOOP
 :donations.donation_type := c1.donation_type;
 :donations.procedure_code := c1.procedure_code;
 :donations.dp_count := c1.cnt;
 create_record;
 next_record;
 END LOOP;
 first_record;
 set_block_property('donations',INSERT_ALLOWED,property_false);
------------
 set_block_property('veni_block',INSERT_ALLOWED,property_true);
 go_block('veni_block');
 --clear_block(no_validate);
 FOR c1 IN bad_count LOOP
 :veni_block.veni_code := c1.attrib_value;
 :veni_block.veni_desc := c1.attrib_desc;
 :veni_block.dp_count := c1.cnt;
 create_record;
 next_record;
 END LOOP;
 first_record;
 set_block_property('veni_block',INSERT_ALLOWED,property_false);
------------
 set_block_property('def_block',INSERT_ALLOWED,property_true);
 go_block('def_block');
 --clear_block(no_validate);
 FOR c1 IN def_count LOOP
 :def_block.inter_code := c1.inter_code;
 :def_block.originated_from := c1.originated_from;
 begin 
 select description into :def_block.description
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'PHYCD' and
 code = c1.originated_from and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception
 when others then
 null; 
 end;
 :def_block.def_count := c1.cnt;
 create_record;
 next_record;
 END LOOP;
 first_record;
 set_block_property('auto_def_block',INSERT_ALLOWED,property_false);
------------
 set_block_property('auto_def_block',INSERT_ALLOWED,property_true);
 go_block('auto_def_block');
 --clear_block(no_validate);
 FOR c1 IN auto_def_count LOOP
 :auto_def_block.inter_code := c1.inter_code;
 :auto_def_block.originated_from := c1.originated_from;
 begin 
 select description into :auto_def_block.description
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'PHYCD' and
 code = c1.originated_from and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception
 when others then
 null; 
 end;
 :auto_def_block.def_count := c1.cnt;
 create_record;
 next_record;
 END LOOP;
 first_record;
 set_block_property('def_block',INSERT_ALLOWED,property_false);


END;
 --populate_donation;
 --check_package_failure;
 go_block('donations');
END;
